name: scoring-v2 for Food Price Pressure (exploratory)
status: frozen before any model run; run exactly once; no rerun after results

origins_and_leads.origin: O(t) = 00:00 PHT on the first day of quarter t+1
origins_and_leads.lead_k: target quarter t+k; k = 1 (the quarter under way at the origin) and k = 2 (the next calendar quarter, the dashboard target)
origins_and_leads.information: only data published before O(t): SWS rounds by posted date, CPI of quarters <= t-1 (labels) and months 1-2 of t (Dnow, rice), news of quarter t (E31 FORECAST rule)

features.definition: E36 as-of features (E32 construction, unchanged): H_last, H_gap, H_trend, H_margin, D_last, Dnow, rice_rel, news_n, news_reg, news_direct_share, fssi_v2, fssi_missing, y_last
features.y_last_redefined: the target's own latest published value at the origin: A -> 1[F(t-1) > 4]; B -> F(t-1); C -> H of the latest quarter whose approved rounds were all posted before the origin
features.limitation_declared_now: the absolute food-inflation level enters only through y_last; the lead-2 COMPACT set has no level feature at all

training_rows: all pairs (X(t'), target of t'+k) with t'+k <= t-1 and the target available before O(t) (A/B: CPI quarter <= t-1; C: all approved rounds posted); rows with a missing feature of the procedure's set are dropped

lead2_E38_operational.note: E38's prior-shift adjustment is NOT used: calibration is now procedure E

B_C_continuous.model: LightGBM regressor, objective regression (L2), same hyperparameters as A per lead

procedures.C_interval: chronological split-conformal 80% interval: q = the ceil(0.8 (n+1))-th smallest absolute residual of the procedure's own earlier out-of-sample forecasts whose outcomes were available before the origin; issued only with >= 8 prior residual DATES, else 'no interval'
procedures.D_coherence: A's P(HIGH) and B's predicted F are separate outputs; report how often 1[P>=0.5] and 1[F_hat > 4] disagree; no coherence is claimed
procedures.E_calibration: Platt scaling: logistic regression (L2, C = 1.0) of the outcome on logit(raw P), fitted only on the procedure's earlier walk-forward predictions whose outcomes were available before the origin; needs >= 8 such prior dates and both classes, otherwise shrinkage: P = 0.5 x raw P + 0.5 x climatology (training HIGH rate, Laplace). No isotonic. Display clipping to [0.02, 0.98] is not calibration and is applied only in displays.
procedures.F_withhold: no forecast (and no baseline score) for an origin whose training rows cover fewer than 8 distinct target quarters
procedures.G_ranking: rank provinces within a quarter by B's predicted F; ties share the average rank (tied flag)

baselines.fitted_on: training rows of the origin only

definitions.persistence: the target's latest published value at the origin (A: 1[F(t-1)>4]; B: F(t-1); C: latest posted H)
definitions.seasonal_naive: the target's value four quarters before the target, if available at the origin, else persistence (flagged)
definitions.AR1: A: logistic regression on y_last; B/C: OLS of the target on y_last, training rows only
definitions.climatology: A: training HIGH rate (Laplace); B/C: training mean
definitions.six_thesis_baselines: A: logistic regression (L2, C=1, standardized, training-mean imputation) on COMB/GOV/NLP and the LightGBM classifier on GOV/NLP with the lead's hyperparameters; B/C: ridge regression (alpha=1, standardized) on COMB/GOV/NLP and the LightGBM regressor on GOV/NLP

unit: the DATE (target quarter). Per-date values first, then averaged over eligible dates. Missing-target quarters and forecast-only quarters are 'Not scored', never errors.

A.brier: B_d = mean over scored provinces of (P - y)^2; Brier = mean of B_d over dates
A.brier_skill: BSS_ref = 1 - Brier_model / Brier_ref over the same dates
A.auc: pooled over eligible province-quarters; date-clustered bootstrap CI; 'not evaluable' with one class; never computed within a date
A.accuracy: diagnostic only, beside always-LOW and always-HIGH; never a headline

B_C.MASE: MAE / mean absolute error of the persistence forecast on the origin's training rows (naive scale from training data only), averaged over dates
B_C.skill: 1 - MAE_model / MAE_ref over the same dates
B_C.coverage: share of scored rows inside the 80% interval; date-clustered bootstrap

ranking.spearman: per date between predicted and observed F (average ranks), only on dates with variation in both; averaged
ranking.top2: |predicted top-2 & observed top-2| / 2 per date, averaged; compared with the 40% chance level
ranking.note: H is shared, so ranking skill can only come from price differences

inference.paired_test: exact sign-flip test (two-sided) on per-date loss differences (Brier for A, absolute error for B/C) between the model and each comparator
inference.multiplicity: Holm over the declared comparison set (primary + secondary, per target and lead)

success_rule: skill is SHOWN only if the skill score against EACH primary comparator (persistence, climatology) is > 0 AND its Holm-adjusted p < 0.05; otherwise 'not demonstrated'. Label A is 'not evaluable' at a lead if HIGH occurs on fewer than 3 independent scored dates; then only B and C are evaluated. No accuracy target; no constant is adjusted.
power_note: about 7-9 independent scored dates per lead and target after withholding; small samples
ledger: runner/e39_ledger.py records every issued forecast (sha256), observed values when released, baseline predictions and per-date scores; scoring a new quarter is mechanical
